test_title: PYST 4: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
**Statements:**

All tables are furniture.

Some furniture is broken.

Which conclusion is true?
solution:
Given Statements:

All tables are furniture.

Some furniture is broken.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/295396032b9a43c47ed006073ec420638956d26bc4ca2a4aa643ea86a90f6003.png] 

**Checking each option:**

 
• **"Some tables are broken"** — False. The broken furniture could belong to chairs, sofas, or other furniture. There is no certainty that any table is among the broken furniture.
 
• **"All tables are broken"** — False. This is an even stronger claim than Option 1. If we cannot confirm even some tables are broken, we certainly cannot say all tables are broken.
 
• **"No table is broken"** — False. This is the opposite extreme. We cannot rule out that some tables may be broken either. No definite negative conclusion can be drawn.
 
• **"Some furniture are tables"** **— True. Since all tables are furniture, it directly and definitely follows that those tables are part of furniture. So some furniture are indeed tables.**
 
• 
 
Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
